reason: Conversation 1 engages with the problem and asks useful questions about whether the pump runs and what the drum does when it stops. It keeps the homeowner within safe limits (unplug first, no panels) and gives a simple Drain/Spin test. It does lean too confidently toward a pump blockage and overstates how accessible the pump is, but it stays tentative, mentions the pressure sensor and wiring as other causes, and says an engineer is needed if the test fails. Conversation 2 only gives a one-line engineer referral without asking for the model number, error-light pattern or any other details, and gives no useful guidance, although its escalation is broadly correct for this fault.
